components.label: subgame-perfect equilibrium of the four-stage crowdfunding game
components.explanation: The model's equilibrium concept is subgame-perfect equilibrium of the four-stage crowdfunding game. The authors solve customer 2's pledge cutoff, the creator's improvement comparison, customer 1's comment choice, and customer 1's initial pledge decision in reverse order. When comments cannot induce improvement, commenting and no commenting are both equilibria because customer 1 is indifferent; the main analysis selects commenting even without anticipated improvement, whereas no commenting arises in the positive-commenting-cost robustness extension.
